description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between four different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—and the number of tokens. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 200. The y-axis has an obscured label covered by a grey rectangle, utilizes a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, and has numeric tick marks at intervals of 10. The "Tutorials" data is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a y-value of approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rising to roughly 27 at 500 tokens, peaking at approximately 29 at 800 tokens, and ending at approximately 28 at 1000 tokens. The "Library Documentation" data is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, beginning at roughly 26 at 200 tokens, increasing to approximately 29 at 500 tokens, peaking at roughly 32 at 800 tokens, and declining to about 27 at 1000 tokens. The "StackOverflow posts" data is depicted by a solid yellow line with circular markers, which exhibits a steady decline from its starting point of approximately 32 at 200 tokens, dropping to roughly 30 at 500 tokens, falling further to roughly 19 at 800 tokens, and finishing at approximately 11 at 1000 tokens. Finally, the "Github files" data is represented by a solid green line with circular markers, starting at approximately 28 at 200 tokens, rising to roughly 30 at 500 tokens, peaking at approximately 32 at 800 tokens, and decreasing to approximately 29 at 1000 tokens.
